qualityNotes: Tier 1: platform documentation, standards, government source, or official help center describing current behavior.
Tier 2: official product/marketing pages, app-store listings, or moderated review pages; useful for feature discovery but claims are not independently validated.
Tier 3: independent reviews, search-derived market evidence, or self-reported user reviews; directional and subject to selection bias.
